Trace, implement and test: leetcode1047 remove all adjacent duplicates in string stack using string

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<string>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    string removeDuplicates(string S) {
        string noDupStr; /* 用字符串模拟栈 */
        for (char& ch : S)
        {
            if (!noDupStr.empty() && noDupStr.back() == ch)
                noDupStr.pop_back();
            else noDupStr.push_back(ch);
        }        
        return noDupStr;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string s = "abbaca";
    // 输出："ca"
    auto res = sol.removeDuplicates(s);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
